package codestructuretype

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// UpdateCodeStructureTypeInput holds update payload.
type UpdateCodeStructureTypeInput struct {
	ID               string
	Code             string
	Name             string
	Description      *string
	ValidatorService *string
}

// UpdateCodeStructureType updates existing structure type.
type UpdateCodeStructureType struct {
	Structures repository.CodeStructureTypeRepository
}

// Handle updates structure type and returns updated value.
func (uc UpdateCodeStructureType) Handle(ctx context.Context, in UpdateCodeStructureTypeInput) (*domain.CodeStructureType, error) {
	structureType, err := uc.Structures.Get(ctx, in.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	structureType.Code = in.Code
	structureType.Name = in.Name
	structureType.Description = in.Description
	structureType.ValidatorService = in.ValidatorService
	if err := uc.Structures.Update(ctx, *structureType); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return uc.Structures.Get(ctx, in.ID)
}
